card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 16 Pro That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 16 Pro That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max Sensor Array 3145728 or 2097152 (0x300000 / 0x200000) points to the charging port flex or the bottom mic / air pressure sensor module.
If water damaged, also check the Taptic Engine (can test unplugged), the air pressure sensor module and the FPC for corrosion.
Sensor value 169 = battery data line: try a new battery, check connector, diode-check and measure data lines; replacing U4000 and U4200 is listed as the board fix.

procedure: 3145728/2097152: known-good charge port flex; ensure air pressure sensor connected; check Taptic and FPC corrosion.
169: new battery, inspect connector, check data lines; replace U4000/U4200 if needed.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Charge port flex / air sensor / battery data
